content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NCPOR Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NCPOR to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Centre for Polar & Ocean Research (NCPOR), an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India, located in Vasco-da-Gama, Goa.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are being offered under NCPOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NCPOR is hiring candidates for Officer positions across various departments, specifically Officer (Finance & Accounts), Officer (Procurement and Stores), and Officer (Administration/General Administration/Services).

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for the Officer (Admn./F&A/P&S) posts distributed among Finance & Accounts, Procurement & Stores, and Administration wings.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of online applications for the NCPOR Officer recruitment is 30-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s Degree from a recognized University along with three years of relevant experience, preferably in a Government Department, Autonomous Body, or PSU.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 50 years. Age relaxations for categories like OBC-NCL, Ex-Servicemen, and PwD are applicable as per standard Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for NCPOR Officer posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of 47,600 INR along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per the applicable institutional guidelines and government pay rules.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for NCPOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website www.ncpor.res.in. Fill out the application form, upload scanned copies of certificates and photos, and submit it online.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: The official notification does not outline any application fee requirement for applying to these contract-based Officer positions at the National Centre for Polar & Ocean Research.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection procedure for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on their academic qualifications and relevant experience, followed by a personal interview for all the screened-in applicants.
